# CG-SRV-003: Server variable values narrowed

A server variable's enum lost values.

**Why it matters:** Server variables select deployments.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Servers](./#srv) |
| Detects | `server.variableEnumNarrowed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A server variable no longer allows some previously documented values.
>
> Consumers configured with a removed value may no longer reach the API.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the values while the corresponding deployments exist.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: region enum narrowed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://{r}.x', variables: {r: {default: us, enum: [us, eu]}}}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://{r}.x', variables: {r: {default: us, enum: [us]}}}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. A server variable no longer allows some previously documented values.

### Does not fire: enum widened

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://{r}.x', variables: {r: {default: us, enum: [us]}}}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://{r}.x', variables: {r: {default: us, enum: [us, eu]}}}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Actual deployments are unknown.
